scheme_name: Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Replantation
other_conditions: Small growers with coffee holdings up to 10 ha are eligible
Replantation applies to old/senile and low‑productive Arabica (age ≥ 25 years) and Robusta (age ≥ 40 years) plantations, and Arabica dwarf varieties (age ≥ 15 years)
For inter‑planting of Arabica in Robusta, subsidy is given only for the Robusta crop
Old/unproductive plants must be removed after one harvest and no later than after two harvests
In areas above 1000 m MSL, only disease‑tolerant, high‑yielding Arabica varieties may be replanted; below 1000 m, Arabica blocks replanted with Robusta material are eligible
In Tamil Nadu, where coffee is intercropped, subsidy is based on the lesser of the actual coffee‑replanted area or the maximum area recorded in land documents
Growers are encouraged to adopt planting designs suitable for mechanisation; estates using such designs may receive subsidy for the entire replanted area
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of 40% of the unit cost (₹2,75,000 per ha for Arabica, ₹2,00,000 per ha for Robusta), with an additional 10% support for SC/ST growers with holdings up to 4 ha.
